excluded_inputs: Family 001 features, fitted models, calibration, predictions, decisions and outcomes
Family 002 tensors, labels, fitted models, ONNX files, predictions, decisions and outcomes
Family 003 pair fits, residuals, z scores, decisions, baskets and outcomes
V1-V8 signals, opportunity timestamps, component labels and economics
material_distinctions: M15 causal online expert performance rather than an H1 full-window supervised fit
single-symbol selection rather than a two-leg residual convergence basket
expert outcomes enter state only after the complete virtual path matures
one global M15 execution slot with dense intraday opportunities

m15_construction.US30_and_US100: aggregate exact UTC-aligned groups of fifteen consecutive M1 rows
m15_construction.complete_group_requirement: timestamps t through t+14 minutes are all present at exact sixty-second spacing
m15_construction.ohlc: first open, maximum high, minimum low, final close on Bid
m15_construction.entry_spread: spread on the first M1 row
m15_construction.exit_spread: spread on the final M1 row
m15_construction.US500: use the native M15 row with its recorded Bid OHLC and spread
m15_construction.common_join: inner join exact M15 opening epoch across US30, US100 and US500

decision.when: first executable tick of every common new M15 bar while the global slot is flat
decision.uses: completed common M15 bars and expert outcomes fully matured before the current bar
decision.capacity_after_exit: next common M15 open after the exit bar
decision.normal_trading_day: server date with at least sixty common M15 bars
decision.lifecycle_start_count: one accepted single-symbol position counts once

expert_population.direction: MOMENTUM follows and REVERSION opposes the sign of log(close[t-1]/close[t-1-h])
expert_population.signal_materiality: absolute source return must be at least 0.10 of the prior 64-bar simple ATR
expert_population.declared_order: US100 then US30 then US500; horizon 1,2,4,8,16; MOMENTUM then REVERSION

virtual_outcome_and_online_state.virtual_decision_frequency: every common M15 bar for every valid expert regardless of candidate slot occupancy
virtual_outcome_and_online_state.virtual_execution: same direction-specific Bid/Ask, one-ATR stop, 1.5R take and four-M15 maximum hold as the candidate
virtual_outcome_and_online_state.virtual_outcome_unit: actual-cost realized planned-risk R clipped to [-3,+3]
virtual_outcome_and_online_state.maturity: the update becomes usable only at the first decision after all four potential holding bars are complete, even if stop or take occurred earlier
virtual_outcome_and_online_state.ewma_initialization: zero weight until at least 256 matured observations exist for that expert
virtual_outcome_and_online_state.ewma_mean_and_variance: causal exponentially weighted first and second moments
virtual_outcome_and_online_state.selection_score: EWMA mean minus 0.25 times sqrt(EWMA variance/effective sample size)
virtual_outcome_and_online_state.ranking: highest finite positive selection score, then declared expert order

atr_volume_and_execution.atr: simple mean true range through the immediately prior completed common M15 bar
atr_volume_and_execution.volume_rounding: floor two-percent one-ATR risk volume to 0.01; use 0.01 below minimum only when planned loss is at most four percent of current actual balance
atr_volume_and_execution.same_bar_stop_and_take_rule: adverse stop wins and threshold execution is used
atr_volume_and_execution.time_exit: direction-specific close at the fourth common M15 bar close

quote_and_cost.stressed_cost: subtract the same direction-specific observed spread burden once again

python_owns: M1-to-M15 construction and three-symbol common-bar state
all thirty expert directions and matured virtual outcomes
role-specific online mean, variance and score
deterministic expert ranking and selected symbol/direction
decision bar, prior ATR and frozen execution metadata
ea_must_own: atomic decision-file schema, sequence and freshness validation
symbol contract, tick size, tick value, lot and market-state validation
current-balance risk sizing and fail-closed order submission
protective stop, take and four-M15 close
restart recovery, ownership, persistence and bounded evidence
adapter_ea_boundary.decision_transport: atomic strict JSON adapter output with monotonically increasing sequence and exact common-M15 epoch

development_gates.selection: highest stressed net among complete passers, then lower drawdown, then higher minimum yearly stressed net

ordered_stages: declaration before source copies, M15 OHLC construction, expert outcomes or candidate economics
byte-equal source materialization and complete adapter implementation freeze with timestamp and expert-state density only
one complete 2024-2025 three-role online development process
locked 2026 confirmation for at most one unchanged complete passer
self-contained EA compile and one native candidate path only for a complete whole-proxy survivor

stop_rules.no_development_passer: close before locked 2026, EA and MT5 without an adjacent expert, horizon, mode, half-life, threshold, risk or exit rescue
stop_rules.environment_or_engineering_fault: correct and rerun without economic verdict or arbitrary retry cap
stop_rules.success: record verified native V8 Challenge victory; Live still requires a separate user-authorized engineering and handoff decision
